ticket.title: Implement Record Types for verification status on AAR child objects

overview: Implement Record Types to differentiate verification status on AAR child objects, supporting the Suggest-Verify-Augment (SVA) pattern with the hybrid workspace approach.

why_record_types_over_picklists: Different page layouts per status (Proposed = read-only, Verified = editable)
Native filtering and list view segmentation

standard_pattern.consolidation_note: Consider combining Verified + Manual Entry record types if page layouts end up identical

manual_entry_only.rationale: No source system for honours/awards — no Proposed record type needed

publications_special_case.rationale: Verification status lives on the junction, NOT on the publication record itself
reasons: One PI verifying doesn't affect another PI's view of the same publication
Each PI sees their own verification status for shared publications

AAR_Recognition__c.notes: Manual entry only — no Proposed needed

UHN_Publication_Author__c.notes: Record Types live on the junction object, not on the publication record

acceptance_criteria: Record Types created on AAR child objects (Recognition, Outputs, Service, etc.)
Page layouts configured per Record Type (Proposed vs Verified/Manual)
Proposed layout has read-only source fields
Junction object Record Types for publications (UHN_Publication_Author__c)
Default Record Type assignment logic documented
Verification mini-Flows can change Record Type (Proposed → Verified) — actual Flows built in BH-1249
technical_notes: Record Type assignment on create: Proposed (if from integration), Manual Entry (if PI-created)
Verification Flow changes Record Type from Proposed → Verified (built in BH-1249)
Consider automation to set Record Type based on Data_Origin__c field
AAR_Recognition__c uses Manual Entry only (no source system for honours/awards)

dependencies.description: AAR Workspace page (uses Record Types for filtering)
Build verification mini-Flows for PI data confirmation on AAR child objects (replaces phantom BH-1034 reference)
dependencies.direction: downstream — depends on BH-1159 completing first
scope: Screen Flows launched via Record Reactor action buttons on Proposed layouts
Proposed → Verified Record Type transition with audit field capture (Verified_By__c, Verified_Date__c)
Publication special case: Flow updates UHN_Publication_Author__c junction, not the publication record
Record Type assignment automation on create (Data_Origin__c → Proposed vs Manual Entry)

dependency_order: BH-1159 (Record Types) MUST complete before BH-1249 (Flows) — the Flows transition between Record Types that BH-1159 creates. Sprint sequencing must reflect this.
references: ADR-001-E: Standard Record Pages vs Screen Flow decision

decision_log.decision: Story created per ADR-001-E — Record Types chosen over picklist fields for verification status.
Phantom dependency flagged: BH-1034 does not exist in the AAR backlog.
Dependency resolved — verification mini-Flows story is BH-1249 under epic BH-1117. BH-1159 must complete before BH-1249.

open_actions: Confirm exact object API name for 'Service Activities' before creating Record Types
Document default Record Type assignment logic (likely based on Data_Origin__c field — confirm field exists on each target object)
Decide whether to consolidate Verified + Manual Entry record types if their page layouts end up identical
Confirm Verified_By__c and Verified_Date__c audit fields exist (or are created) on objects targeted by BH-1249 Flows
